schema.description: Single source of truth for all Afterfade contact channels. SOPs and KB files should reference this file instead of hardcoding contact details.

whatsapp.label: Support — the only official WhatsApp channel
whatsapp.note: Never use or share any other WhatsApp number for customer support

return_addresses.note: The return address is communicated once the return request is approved and registered. Afterfade BV may direct returns to a specific address or logistics partner.
